description: The scene shows a wide, continuous paved pedestrian path/sidewalk along the right edge with a curb and a tactile/brick-pattern strip near the curb; the surface appears even and in good condition, with landscaped beds and evenly spaced trees providing shade. Traffic is separated from pedestrians by a landscaped verge and curb, with vehicles parked along the right; the roadway looks low-speed and there are no visible barriers or medians directly between pedestrians and cars. Lighting is not prominent in this daytime view, and there are few obstacles in the walking area, though the main pedestrian route is somewhat channelized by the landscaped edges.
